description: This file manages device bootstrap tokens, including issuing, revoking, validating, and retrieving bootstrap profiles, with support for locking and persistence.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for bootstrap data based on optional base directory.

methods.name: resolvePersistedBootstrapProfile
methods.description: Normalizes the profile from a record, handling partial data.

methods.name: resolvePersistedRedeemedProfile
methods.description: Normalizes the redeemed profile from a record.

methods.name: resolveIssuedBootstrapProfile
methods.description: Creates an issued bootstrap profile based on input parameters, defaulting if none provided.

methods.name: bootstrapProfileAllowsRequest
methods.description: Checks if a profile allows a specific role and scope request.

methods.name: resolveBootstrapProfileScopes
methods.description: Filters scopes based on role, separating operator and non-operator scopes.

methods.name: bootstrapProfileSatisfiesProfile
methods.description: Verifies if an actual profile satisfies the required profile's roles and scopes.

methods.name: normalizeBootstrapPublicKey
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a public key string, handling different formats.

methods.name: loadState
methods.description: Loads the bootstrap token state from a JSON file, pruning expired tokens.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Persists the bootstrap token state to a JSON file.

methods.name: issueDeviceBootstrapToken
methods.description: Issues a new bootstrap token with optional profile, roles, and scopes.

methods.name: clearDeviceBootstrapTokens
methods.description: Removes all bootstrap tokens from storage.

methods.name: restoreDeviceBootstrapToken
methods.description: Restores a bootstrap token record into storage.

methods.name: getDeviceBootstrapTokenProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile associated with a bootstrap token.

methods.name: redeemDeviceBootstrapTokenProfile
methods.description: Redeems a bootstrap token, updating its profile with role and scope, and checks for full redemption.

methods.name: verifyDeviceBootstrapToken
methods.description: Verifies a bootstrap token against device ID, public key, role, and scopes.

methods.name: getBoundDeviceBootstrapProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile for a device that has been verified and bound to a token.
